changes: Player.ino four movement branches consolidated in core.cpp, retaining lower/upper board layers.
Direction plus bit 0x10 records box pushes; LifoBuffer.ino circular rewind adapted to static 2048-byte storage.
Added complete one- and two-cell bounds checks, moves/push counters, completion/unlock persistence, CRC-32 validation.
Arduino sound, animation and button flags replaced with PXA hooks; no upstream levels or graphical assets imported.

levels.selection: Offline push BFS on first 64 boards; choose 32 successful solutions with shortest walking path length, ties by dataset id.
levels.conversion: Unchanged 10x10 ASCII geometry copied to SELECTED.txt and concatenated into C++ string arrays in levels.hpp; original dataset ids retained.
levels.citation: Arthur Guez et al. An investigation of Model-free planning: boxoban levels. 2018. https://github.com/deepmind/boxoban-levels/

original.scope: Two tutorial layouts (dataset_id -1,-2), UI, geometric graphics, 96x96 icon PNG/SVG, tests and build glue.
